description: This file contains functions for managing channel doctor configurations, including listing channel entries, running configuration sequences, collecting mutations and warnings, and handling allowlist warnings. It interacts with external plugin registry and types, and provides exported functions for configuration management.

classes.name: ChannelDoctorEntry
classes.description: Type representing a channel ID and its associated doctor plugin.

methods.name: listChannelDoctorEntries
methods.description: Retrieves a list of channel entries with their associated doctor plugins, filtering out entries without a doctor.

methods.name: runChannelDoctorConfigSequences
methods.description: Runs configuration sequences for all channel doctors and collects change and warning notes.

methods.name: collectChannelDoctorCompatibilityMutations
methods.description: Collects configuration mutations to ensure compatibility based on current config.

methods.name: collectChannelDoctorStaleConfigMutations
methods.description: Collects mutations to clean stale configurations for channel doctors.

methods.name: collectChannelDoctorPreviewWarnings
methods.description: Collects preview warnings from all channel doctors.

methods.name: collectChannelDoctorMutableAllowlistWarnings
methods.description: Collects warnings related to mutable allowlists from all channel doctors.

methods.name: collectChannelDoctorRepairMutations
methods.description: Collects mutations to repair channel doctor configurations, including warnings.

methods.name: collectChannelDoctorEmptyAllowlistExtraWarnings
methods.description: Collects extra warnings related to empty allowlists.

methods.name: shouldSkipChannelDoctorDefaultEmptyGroupAllowlistWarning
methods.description: Determines if default empty group allowlist warning should be skipped based on channel doctor entries.
